title: knit xmas stockings
text: knit xmas stockings. This are very large and very nice.  HOWEVER.. the insides are NOT lined and so the yarn hooks on everything you try to put in them!  I really love the colors..and the size... I just wish they would have done a little bit better and lined them.  I am not sure what I am going to do, or if there is a way to insert a lining... even partially down.  I deeply regret I couldn't rate these higher.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I probably will search for something lined and donate these.  *sigh*
